content: You didn't come into this world. You came out of it, like a wave from the ocean. You are not a stranger here.
author: Alan Watts
story:
A former Anglican priest who immersed himself in Eastern philosophy, Alan Watts became a pioneering voice in mid-century California, bridging Taoism, Vedanta, and Zen with Western psychology. Confronting the frantic anxieties of modern consumerism and mechanistic materialism, Watts illuminated the illusion of the separate ego, inviting people to realize they are the entire cosmos experiencing itself.

In formulating this reflection, Alan Watts stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of ocean. For Alan Watts, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: How does adopting this philosophical view alter the way you handle current friction?
